verdict.rationale: Circle's docs clearly document support for USDC and EURC across multiple blockchains via CCTP, Gateway, and Bridge Kit (chain-abstracted balances, burn-and-mint transfers), and Circle Mint conversions, but the evidence never lists specific named networks (e.g. Ethereum, Solana, Base) nor mentions USDT or other issuers' stablecoins — Circle's docs focus on its own stablecoins rather than a broad multi-issuer/multi-chain compatibility matrix. missing for 10: explicit named-chain list, USDT/other stablecoin support documentation, independent confirmation of chain coverage.
